# Vibe Mode animal reactions

These 19 photos were selected from the user-provided “goofy animal photos” folder and resized to a maximum 640-pixel edge as WebP. The original files are unchanged. `manifest.json` maps app assets to the supplied filenames; original authors/licenses were not supplied and are not invented here.

Captions describe app check-ins and fictional playful reactions, not medical or nutrition assessments. Images appear only while the active KainCheck coach has Vibe Mode enabled. Health cautions and connection errors do not display chat reaction images. The app does not send these photos to an AI provider.

The glam-pigeon reaction accompanies casual exaggerated food claims in Vibe Mode. Sarcasm is followed by factual guidance in the same reply; personal health risks, food safety and errors stay serious.
